title: Tín hiệu cuối
about: Round x8, in directions of my own choosing, as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm nhiều bài nữa, hướng bạn tự đề xuất"): darkwave: the last signal from a lost station, the synth bass pulsing, the cold arpeggio in sixteenths, a soft beat, the far choir over it. E minor at 88 bpm. An original piece.
